simroute_palma_barna.title: SIMROUTE Palma de Mallorca to Barcelona reference case
simroute_palma_barna.citation: Grifoll, M., Boren, C., Castells-Sanabra, M. (2022), Ocean Engineering 255, 111427, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.oceaneng.2022.111427
simroute_palma_barna.license: No license file in repository; no upstream code copied

independent_reproduction.implementation: Clean Python/NumPy A* reimplementation from the published algorithm and inspected source behaviour; no upstream code copied. The archived case tree was used only as validation input.

caveats: The current repository head uses a later refactor and a different wave-prepare file convention; the bundled Palma report belongs to the 2021 snapshot above.
The published report rounds hours and miles to two decimals. Reproduction is exact to floating-point roundoff before rounding.
No licence file was present at either inspected commit. The implementation is independent and does not redistribute upstream source.

visir2.title: VISIR-2 ship weather routing in Python
visir2.citation: Mannarini, G., Salinas, M. L., Carelli, L., Petacco, N., Orovic, J. (2024), Geoscientific Model Development 17, 4355-4382, https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-17-4355-2024

inspected_algorithm.search: time-dependent Dijkstra with edge weights from arrival-time-indexed wave and current fields
inspected_algorithm.current_composition: SOG = w_parallel + sqrt(STW^2 - w_cross^2), with negative SOG masked
inspected_algorithm.wave_effect: vessel performance curve gives STW as a function of wave angle and height
inspected_algorithm.graph: projected Cartesian graph; coast screens and edge-length geometry outside the search

visir2.reason: The original VISIR-2 code reproduced the official small analytic-current benchmark. The full Alboran current-and-wind numerical case was not run, because it needs the official graph, S175 performance models and large external environmental products. This repository does not redistribute or copy upstream VISIR-2 source or those inputs.
assumptions_for_tide_adaptation: No VISIR-2 vessel performance curve for S175 is available here.
The TIDE adaptation therefore uses an Aertssen wave-speed proxy and the published current composition.
Empirical edge times only rank and time candidate routes. Full Session physics decides passage, cargo and failure outcomes.
The TIDE adaptations do not reproduce all upstream features and do not replace TIDE physics.

simroute.algorithm: A* on a bounded local grid with Aertssen speed loss, no current, midpoint time predictor
simroute.why_not_bowditch_in_gameplay: The faithful Bowditch reference model gives sub-knot speeds for the 175 m S175 at storm Hs, so the game adaptation uses SIMROUTE's Aertssen WEN_form=2 instead.
simroute.reference_exercise: simroute_palma_barna reproduces the Bowditch WEN_form=1 benchmark independently.

visir2.algorithm: time-dependent Dijkstra, Aertssen speed-loss proxy, VISIR-2 current composition, headings separated from ground courses
visir2.reference_exercise: The TIDE solver is not an execution of VISIR-2. The separate visir2.reproduction entry records the official analytic-current pass. The TIDE adaptation does not reproduce the upstream graph, full performance model or Alboran numerical benchmark.
